title: Cerebrum — AI-Powered Note-Taking Platform
bullets: AI Integration: Integrated Grok API (xAI) to enable real-time note summarization, writing improvement suggestions, and auto-generated smart tags — reducing manual tagging effort to zero.
RAG Architecture: Implemented retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to surface contextually relevant notes during AI-assisted queries, improving response precision.
UX Engineering: Built a 5-second debounced auto-save system and fast note creation flow; implemented smart search across titles and content, cutting time-to-note by ~60%.
Frontend: Delivered dark-mode UI with Framer Motion animations and shimmering skeleton loading states; fully responsive layout with mobile-optimized sidebar.
Auth & Security: Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication with Google secure login/registration flows.

title: Full-Stack Travel Booking Platform
bullets: System Design: Architected end-to-end system including MongoDB schema modeling, REST API route structure, and scalable booking flow logic from ground up.
Performance: Reduced MongoDB query latency by ~40% by applying compound indexes on high-frequency search fields (destination, date range, price tier).
Asset Delivery: Integrated Cloudinary CDN for image upload and delivery, replacing local storage and improving media load performance.
Deployment: Deployed via Vercel serverless functions with automated email notifications on booking confirmation.

title: Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform
bullets: Designed a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system supporting Admin, Vendor, and Customer roles with granular route-level protection middleware.
Implemented JWT authentication with token expiry, refresh logic, and secure API architecture ensuring protected endpoints across all vendor operations.
Built global state management with Redux Toolkit to handle cart state, auth state, and real-time product inventory across multi-vendor storefronts.
